arguments.summary: A coordinated attack originated from the compromised workstation WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), owned by user jsmith. Initial compromise likely occurred via a malicious update to liblzma (CVE-2024-3094). The threat actor deployed Cobalt Strike (detected via IDS) for C2 communication, performed credential dumping, and attempted lateral movement via SMB. Credentials for admin_jsmith were exfiltrated and appeared on the dark web. Subsequent brute-force attempts and anomalous Kerberos requests from other internal IPs (10.0.5.14, 10.0.6.99) indicate use of stolen credentials. Despite detection, critical response actions (credential revocation, firewall block) were denied, highlighting a policy or workflow gap. A full EPP scan successfully detected and reported the exploit on the source host.
